source_title: SCCM Guidelines for Allocation of Critical Care Resources During Crisis-Level Shortages
clinical_context: Use when WardCoordinator summarizes resource limitation and triage context for human leadership review.
key_points: Crisis-level shortages are severe deficits of essential resources and services that drastically affect critical care delivery.
The guideline emphasizes evidence-based practices and processes, but reports limited evidence for many specific triage scenarios.
The card supports review structure only and cannot allocate scarce resources automatically.
resource_context: Crisis-level shortages include products, personnel, and facilities.
fairness_or_ethics_note: Use fair, transparent human processes; do not automate allocation or denial.

evidence_location.quote: Crisis-level shortages refer to severe deficits
